name: Bald Eagle
intro: A bald eagle is a big bird with a white head. It lives near water in North America.

sections.title: What does it look like?
sentences: A bald eagle is a very big bird.
It has a white head and a white tail.
Its body and wings are dark brown.
It has a yellow beak and yellow feet.
Its open wings are wider than a grown-up is tall.

sections.title: Where does it live?
sentences: Bald eagles live in North America.
They live near water.
They like lakes, rivers, and the coast.
Many bald eagles live in Alaska and Canada.
They build nests at the top of tall trees.

sections.title: What does it eat?
sentences: Bald eagles are predators.
They eat mostly fish.
They swoop low over the water.
They catch fish with their feet.
They also eat ducks and small animals.

sections.title: How does it grow?
sentences: A mother eagle usually lays two eggs.
Both parents take turns keeping the eggs warm.
Baby eagles are called eaglets.
Eaglets are gray at first and then turn brown.
They get white heads at about four or five years old.

sections.title: Fun facts
sentences: A bald eagle is not really bald.
Its head is covered with white feathers.
Bald eagles can spot a fish from far away.
The bald eagle is a symbol of the United States.
The biggest eagle nest ever found was as heavy as a car.
